arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Essence Cost: {/c}{c_resource}{Resource Cost}{/c}
Curse the target area. Enemies afflicted by {c_important}Decrepify{/c} are {c_important}{u}Weakened{/c}{/u} and Slowed by {c_number}[{SF_3}*100|1%|]{/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:DECREPIFY_CURSE}{/c} seconds.
The first time an enemy is afflicted with {c_important}Decrepify{/c} they are {c_important}{u}Dazed{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_22|1|]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Decrepify{/c} is also a {c_important}Blood{/c} Skill, healing for {c_number}[{SF_24}*100|%1|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * SF_24)|0|]){/c} whenever you hit an enemy afflicted with it, up to once a second.

Enemies that die while afflicted with {c_important}Decrepify{/c} have a {c_number}[{SF_25}*100|%|]{/c} chance to form a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/c}{/u}.
Instead of afflicting enemies {c_important}Decrepify{/c} is now applied to your {c_important}Minions{/c}, granting them {c_number}[{SF_28} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased Cast Speed and Movement Speed.
You have an additional {c_number}[{SF_20}*100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance against enemies afflicted with {c_important}Decrepify{/c}.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Enemies hit while afflicted with {c_important}Decrepify{/c} have up to a {c_number}[{SF_7}*100|%|]{/c} chance to reduce a random active Cooldown by {c_number}[{SF_8}]{/c} second.
Each enemy afflicted with {c_important}Decrepify{/c} increases your Movement Speed by {c_number}[{SF_21}*100|x%|]{/c}.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Enemies hit while afflicted with {c_important}Decrepify{/c} have up to a {c_number}[{SF_19}*100|%|]{/c} chance to grant {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/c}{/u}.
